descriptions.d24i_trail_spawn_8012ad58: Emit one trail particle when at least 2048 time units passed since the slot's stamp (table +328 indexed by cursor +936 + 100): stamps the slot with now (+940) - 200, opens the particle arrays of the buffer +928, writes the slot's random rotation (angle below 360 in radians), position (source x and z with height -0.5f) and colour 0x00ffffff, and wraps the cursor after 50 slots.
